wins: Completed full network reconnaissance and mapped 32 hosts within target subnet (ep001_step08).
Enumerated web service versions and captured consistent banner data for prioritized hosts (ep001_step12).
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to missing exploit paths after initial web enumeration (ep001_step20).
Authentication attempts blocked by account lockout policies, preventing lateral movement (ep001_step22).
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase performed solidly, but inability to pivot beyond initial foothold and repeated privilege escalation failures stalled mission.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated privilege escalation attempts stalled after web service enumeration without credible exploit chains.

skill_cards.if_condition: When host enumeration reveals Apache 2.4.x with PHP modules
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted web vulnerability scan focusing on CVE-2021-41773 and directory traversal scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares listed but access denied
skill_cards.then_action: Use CrackMapExec with domain credentials to enumerate share permissions and identify writable targets

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service detected with default banner
skill_cards.then_action: Perform aggressive credential spraying followed by SSH key brute forcing with hydra

memory_ops.reason: High success rate correlating Apache enumeration to actionable exploits.

next_experiments.title: Integrate privilege escalation chains post-web enumeration
next_experiments.description: After confirming Apache/CVE opportunities, pivot to container escape or local privilege escalation scripts (e.g., linPEAS, gtfobins) on discovered hosts to break out of limited service shells.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse across SMB/SSH services
next_experiments.description: Take validated web service credentials and test reuse on SMB and SSH targets with CrackMapExec/hydra to uncover lateral movement paths without relying on new brute force.

next_experiments.title: Automate detection of locked accounts to adjust brute force pace
next_experiments.description: Implement cooldown tracking in brute force scripts (hydra/cewl) to prevent account lockouts and enable longer attack windows.
